name: risk-browser-game
description: Risk-style browser strategy game with MCP agent support

scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @risk/shared-types && npm run build --workspace @risk/game-engine && npm run dev --workspace @risk/web
scripts.dev:server: npm run build --workspace @risk/shared-types && npm run build --workspace @risk/game-engine && npm run dev --workspace @risk/server
scripts.dev:mcp: npm run build --workspace @risk/shared-types && npm run dev --workspace @risk/mcp-server
scripts.dev:cli: npm run build --workspace @risk/shared-types && npm run build --workspace @risk/game-engine && npm run dev --workspace @risk/cli
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @risk/shared-types && npm run build --workspace @risk/game-engine && npm run build --workspace @risk/server && npm run build --workspace @risk/mcp-server && npm run build --workspace @risk/cli && npm run build --workspace @risk/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @risk/shared-types && npm run typecheck --workspace @risk/game-engine && npm run typecheck --workspace @risk/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @risk/mcp-server && npm run typecheck --workspace @risk/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace @risk/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @risk/game-engine && npm run test --workspace @risk/server
